derivation: Anchors re-derived independently from this ROM's own 68000 instructions; the grammar is unchanged from the Story of Thor profile, which is what makes this a generalisation test rather than a re-fit.

banner_z80.text: Ancient Music Driver -MD- Z80 Program Version 1.00

z80_image.evidence: lea.l $1a9fae,a1 / lea.l $a00000,a2 / move.w #$1fff,d0 / move.b (a1)+,(a2)+ / dbra d0 / move.w #$0,$a11200 / move.w #$0,$a11100

song_index.value_semantics: offset of the song header relative to table_rom_offset; 0 = slot not used

track_header.value_semantics: offset of the track stream relative to the song header address itself; 0 = empty slot
track_header.evidence: same LE16 fetch + add.l base idiom as the Story of Thor profile

command_jump_table.encoding: big-endian uint16, relative to the table address
command_jump_table.note: Operand widths were proven handler-by-handler in Story of Thor. This ROM shares the dispatcher shape; per-handler widths were NOT re-derived here, so the extractor applies them and flags any stream that stops on 0xf4/0xfc/0xff.

pitch_table.evidence: move.b (a0)+,d0 / andi.b #$f,d0 / add.w d0,d0 / lea $1a9f1e(pc),a2 / move.w (a2,d0.w),d1

limitations: Command operand widths are inherited from the Story of Thor profile and were not re-derived per handler in this ROM.
Instrument, FM/PSG voice and sample representations are out of scope for this profile.
The pitch word table is an opaque code; no note-name mapping is claimed.
rom_sha256_note: sha-256 of the normalised image; this ROM has no trailing padding run, so it equals the container member hash (3145728 B).
